description: The Pottsville 1882 estate page the delegation names by ARK, read to confirm one fact. It shows Thomas Flynn's estate entry, so the confirmation succeeds.

response.transcription:
Register of Wills, Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania. 1882.

No. 412. Estate of Thomas Flynn, late of Pottsville, laborer, deceased. Letters testamentary granted 9 February 1882 to Patrick Flynn, son and executor.
